The PKGBUILD file defines a standard Arch Linux package build configuration for `tideftp-bin`, a precompiled binary release of the TideFTP client. It fetches a static binary from the project's official GitHub releases page (https://github.com/allisonhere/TideFTP), which is consistent with the declared upstream URL. The source URLs use HTTPS and point to specific tagged release versions, ensuring transparency and traceability.

Checksums (sha256sums) are provided for all architecture-specific sources, including both x86_64 and aarch64 variants, which ensures integrity of the downloaded binaries. The package installs the binary to `/usr/bin/tideftp` and the license file to the appropriate location under `/usr/share/licenses/`. No suspicious operations such as dynamic code downloads, obfuscated commands, or unauthorized network activity are present.

The build process is minimal and appropriate for a binary package: it disables stripping (justified in the comment, as the upstream binary is already stripped), and does not execute any unexpected scripts or modify system state beyond standard file installation. All dependencies and optional dependencies are clearly declared and related to legitimate functionality (clipboard support). There is no evidence of malicious behavior or supply-chain attack vectors.
</details>
